text:
Alex K: Quick sync request — need to lock vendor certification windows for H100/H200, B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Specifically: lab availability, which image tags we’ll test (partner-provided vs our RC), perf pass thresholds, and marketing/marketplace embargo dates. Can we do a short call tomorrow 9am PT?
Maria P: 9am PT works for me. Quick q: do vendors expect us to use their AMIs/images or produce a Redwood RC image? Nvidia sent something labeled `2026-05-h100-rc1` but they said a driver patch might land Thursday.
Vikram S: My proposal — accept partner-provided images but wrap them with a tiny `redwood-compat` layer (env+drivers pin) and publish a harmonized tag format: `redwood/compat:<vendor>-<hw>-rcYYYYMMDD`. CI will run a perf/regression harness. Perf pass = <=10% latency regression vs our baseline and >=98% correctness on eval prompt set. If fails, auto-fallback to validated model variant for marketplace.
Anna O: Lab note: we have rack space for H200 and B200 next week (Mon-Wed). Gaudi nodes available week after. MI300 is vendor-provisioned — need to request loaner and schedule a 2-week window. Please file a lab ticket with hardware type + requested dates.
Jamie L: Marketplace items we need: AMI/OVA URLs, recommended instance types & sizing guidance, helm chart + values, and a short runbook for SI. Can we standardize instance names? My suggestion: `rwd.h100.small|medium|large` mapping to vendor SKUs. Also need sample pricing ranges for docs.
partners-bot: Vendor CI statuses (summary):
- Nvidia H100: image posted `2026-05-h100-rc1` (driver patch pending)
- Nvidia H200: internal RC tomorrow
- Habana Gaudi: nightly images available, kernel 5.19 required
- AMD MI300: currently in vendor lab; awaiting loaner confirmation
- B200 (B200X): OEM image stable, needs cuda/cuDNN matrix checks
Maria P: On embargos — vendors are asking for 48h embargo before public announce. I recommend we set internal freeze/embargo of 72h so legal + marketplace checks can complete; external embargo 48h is fine if we commit to a final build at T-72. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Vikram S: agreed on T-72 freeze. Also: add a perf smoke job that runs a 1k-token worst-case seq length test to catch tail-latency regressions. We can set an automated alert if p95 increases >12%.
Anna O: I'll open lab tickets today for H200/B200 and request MI300 loaner. Please tag me with the preferred windows.
Jamie L: I'll draft the marketplace asset checklist and a sample `instance-mapping.md` by EOD.
Alex K: Action items — I’ll create a short agenda and PRD. Owners: Vikram = image tag format + CI thresholds; Anna = lab scheduling + ticket; Jamie = marketplace asset pack; Maria = embargo signoff + vendor confirmations. I’ll ping Legal for embargo language. If everyone OK, I’ll send calendar invite for 9am PT. :white_check_mark:
Maria P: OK from my side.
Vikram S: On it.
Anna O: I'll take the MI300 request when you post dates.
Jamie L: +1, will prepare assets.
